name: Seventy-Two Earthly Transformations
origin: Patriarch Subodhi · Mount Lingtai Fangcun · the Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars
nature: Transformation art · avoiding the three calamities
philosophy: Earthly in number, of yin nature; governs transformation and concealment — avoiding calamity and hiding one's true form
pros: Infinite transformations; can avoid the three calamities (thunder / fire / wind)
cons: Tail feathers hard to hide (turning into a temple leaves the tail exposed); a transformed object cannot exceed its original form

name: Thirty-Six Heavenly Transformations
practitioner: Zhu Bajie (teacher unclear, possibly the Zhenwu Emperor or the Mysterious Maiden)
origin: Unclear (tied to his rank as Marshal Tianpeng)
philosophy: Heavenly in number, of yang nature; governs the true transformation of origin, with deep mana
pros: Pure transformations; strong power of origin
cons: Fewer in number; inflexible in the heat of battle

name: True Samadhi Fire
philosophy: Samadhi means the unity of essence, breath and spirit; its true fire is beyond compare with ordinary fire
pros: Water cannot douse it; its smoke can wound; Wukong cannot approach
cons: Fears the willow water of Guanyin's vase and the East Sea Dragon King's water

name: Somersault Cloud
philosophy: One somersault covers one hundred and eight thousand li
cons: Cannot carry others (except himself) for long

name: Fiery Golden Eyes
practitioner: Sun Wukong (forged in the Eight Trigrams Furnace)
origin: Taishang Laojun's Eight Trigrams Furnace · wind and smoke at the Xun position
philosophy: Smoked into being in the Eight Trigrams Furnace; can recognize demons and tell true from false
pros: Sees through a demon's true form
cons: Fears smoke (Red Boy's smoke can blind)
